_meta.description: 七情 between herbs of the knowledge base: the table of 《本草綱目·序例下》「相須相使相畏相惡諸藥」 (after 徐之才《藥對》), each relation with the entry it was read from, and the textbook examples of 相須 (unverified). Derived drafts until the pharmacy review.

types.相使: `other` serves `herb`: it strengthens the herb's action (「X為之使」, 「得X良」)
types.相反: the two must not be combined; never computed — the safety rules exclude the pair
types.相惡: `herb` dislikes `other`: the other takes away from the herb's effect (人參惡萊菔子)
types.相畏: `herb` fears `other`: the other restrains the herb's harm (半夏畏生薑; seen from the other side, 相殺)
types.相須: two herbs of like action strengthen each other
